title: GENDER REPRESENTATION AND BIAS IN INDIAN CIVIL SERVICE MOCK INTERVIEWS

bias_targets.methodology: The paper measures gender bias through unigram differential analysis of interview transcripts, Word Embedding Association Tests (WEAT) comparing career versus family terms, semantic clustering of questions by topic to find gender representation imbalances, text separability tests training a BERT classifier to predict the candidate's gender from the question asked, and analyzing the differential unigram distribution of LLM-generated rationales in a zero-shot gender inference task.
